I should implement a way to identify horizontal separators with full same-color rows and vertical separators with full same-color columns, maybe using two colors.

{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u023/system/state/workspace/programs/task-d393d66e.py",
 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform full rows/columns are the dividers between panels.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    separators = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    # Background is the most common non-divider color in the panels.
    counts = Counter(v for r, row in enumerate(grid) if r not in sep_rows
                     for c, v in enumerate(row) if c not in sep_cols and v not in separators)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(v for v in counts if v != background)

    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        y0, y1 = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1]
        out_row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            x0, x1 = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1]
            n = sum(grid[y][x] == marker for y in range(y0, y1) for x in range(x0, x1))
            out_row.append(1 if n == 2 else background)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
